Our Story

Your local
style stop

DRIP STORE started as a neighbourhood shop for people who care about how they dress. We keep it real — no hype, just good fits at honest prices.

Wide-leg & baggy jeans in every wash
Shirts for every occasion — casual to semi-formal
Oversized graphic hoodies & sweatshirts
Women's tops, kurtis & blouses
Sizes S to 3XL available in store
New drops every week

Privacy Policy

Effective: 1 January 2025 · India DPDP Act, 2023

This website does not collect personal data automatically. If you contact us via WhatsApp or email, only that communication is stored by the respective platform (WhatsApp/Google).

Your rights (DPDP Act 2023)

  • Right to access your data
  • Right to correction
  • Right to erasure — email hello@dripstore.in with subject "Data Deletion Request"
  • Right to withdraw consent

Cookies
